title: "Engineer course setup"

## Install a released wheel

Install the CPython 3.12 prebuilt wheel from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim/releases/tag/v1.0.0a3). Start in an empty folder and initialize a project:

```sh
uv init --python 3.12
```

Choose the command matching your operating system and architecture:

<details>
<summary>Windows x86_64 (AMD64)</summary>

```powershell
uv add "scnsim @ https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim/releases/download/v1.0.0a3/scnsim-1.0.0a3-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl"
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>macOS arm64</summary>

```sh
uv add "scnsim @ https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim/releases/download/v1.0.0a3/scnsim-1.0.0a3-cp312-cp312-macosx_12_0_arm64.whl"
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>Linux x86_64</summary>

```sh
uv add "scnsim @ https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim/releases/download/v1.0.0a3/scnsim-1.0.0a3-cp312-cp312-manylinux1_x86_64.manylinux_2_28_x86_64.manylinux_2_5_x86_64.whl"
```

</details>

| Python | Platform and architecture | Wheel |
|---|---|---|
| CPython 3.12 | Windows x86_64 (AMD64) | [Release wheel](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim/releases/download/v1.0.0a3/scnsim-1.0.0a3-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl) |
| CPython 3.12 | macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon) | [Release wheel](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim/releases/download/v1.0.0a3/scnsim-1.0.0a3-cp312-cp312-macosx_12_0_arm64.whl) |
| CPython 3.12 | Linux x86_64 | [Release wheel](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim/releases/download/v1.0.0a3/scnsim-1.0.0a3-cp312-cp312-manylinux1_x86_64.manylinux_2_28_x86_64.manylinux_2_5_x86_64.whl) |

These prebuilt wheels do not require a C++ compiler. For other Python versions or platforms, follow the [Contribution guide's source-build instructions](../../docs/contribute.qmd#build-from-source).

## Optional Jupyter setup

Add Jupyter to the project only if you want to run notebooks:

```sh
uv add --dev jupyterlab ipykernel
uv run jupyter lab
```

Use the course notebooks from a full source checkout, which provides `examples.engineer.diagram_layouts`. See the [Contribution guide](../../docs/contribute.qmd) for checkout and build instructions.
